svg.title: Regulated IQ: officer-isolated PDF chat with Foundry and Teams
svg.desc: Proposed Caldova architecture. Orange Portal upload path to private officer-specific Blob storage, gated extraction and approval, blue authenticated Teams chat and officer-authorized retrieval. Processing identity and approval gates remain unresolved.

text.tspan: Regulated IQ: officer-isolated PDF chat with Foundry and Teams
Caldova commercial PoC | Synthetic PDFs | Implementation target - native Foundry Activity, no Container Apps
Orange: Portal upload, validation, approval, indexing
Blue: officer question and grounded answer
Grey dashed: identity, private access and audit
No VPN or private desktop required
Private containers; no keys or SAS
No PDF, prompt or answer bodies
Azure private services and VNet-connected runtime
Private Foundry/Search + DNS; authenticated public Blob uploads; runtime connectivity must be proven
Officer B: separate data security domain
Separate container, identity and search domain
A cannot access B via Blob, tools, answers or citations
No shared data identity, vector store or conversation
C Retrieve A-only approved passages / citations
IMPLEMENTATION GATES: trusted caller identity; machine-read authorization; independent approval; private runtime connectivity.
Human access stays officer-specific. Processing identities and approval authority need authorization; live cross-officer tests are not yet run.
Target design - not an as-built inventory. No Container Apps hosting.
